reactor_type: Chemical beam epitaxy (CBE) with N2 laser irradiation
evidence: The temperature of TEGa was kept constant in a thermostat. The flow rates of TEGa (FTEGa) were precisely controlled between 0.015 and 0.100 sccm by a mass-flow controller without H2 carrier gas. The pressure of the chamber during epitaxy was maintained in the order of 10 -5 torr. The substrate temperature was varied between 290 and 500 °C.
